messages:
support_jen: FYI — ACME reported a burst of 503s from hosted inference starting ~15:20 UTC. They say it coincided with a surge of auth-heavy streaming requests. customer escalated to CS.
eng_matt: Any crash logs/stack traces yet?
support_jen: Pasting the top-level log snippet from the gateway forwarded by CS: 
```
[2026-03-18T15:20:21Z] upstream-runner[pid=4123]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8e4a1b2f3 libtorch.so+0x12ab0
[2026-03-18T15:20:21Z] infer-worker[pid=4123]: GPU 0 OOM while allocating 12.3GB
[2026-03-18T15:20:22Z] containerd: killing container infer-runner-4123: exit code 137
```
support_jen: CS attached a short timeline — spike in auth token validations -> long tool-calls -> memory surge.
ml_oncall: Repro tried on staging with ACME dataset and high concurrent streams (20 clients) — saw one runner OOM after ~6 minutes. I'll dump nvml and core log.
ml_oncall: nvml snapshot: 
```
GPU 0 memUsed: 47.9G / 48.0G
Process 4123 (infer-runner) using 46.8G
```
eng_matt: Are these requests using tool-calls or function-calling? That changes KV prefetch behavior.
support_jen: CS: many requests had toolcall payloads and long output streaming.
sre_lead: Immediate mitigation: enable fallback routing to Dedicated pool for ACME; set max_concurrency=4 for their route, and temporarily enable model-variant with quantized profile. Can we push in 10m?
eng_matt: I can flip routing policy and lower concurrency now. Will also push a temporary model pin to quantized-8bit variant for that customer.
eng_matt: Quick note — quantized variant reduces peak mem per-worker by ~40% in our perf tests.
ml_oncall: For repro steps: run local runner with these envs: 
```sh
CONCURRENCY=20 ./runner --model acme/llama-embed --enable-toolcalls
# feed the sample stream payloads from /tmp/acme-burst.json
```
ml_oncall: Also observe that token-prefetch + toolcall output buffering holds KV cache much longer leading to mem growth.
support_jen: Customer is seeing billing anomalies during the incident (unexpected retries). CS is asking for a timeline and mitigation to avoid double-charging.
sre_lead: Make a billing freeze for the window 15:20-15:28 and visible note on customer dashboard. Ops, please tag invoices.
eng_matt: I captured a minimal backtrace from core dump: 
```
#0  0x7f8e4a1b2f3 in aten::conv_forward ()
#1  0x7f8e4a1c0aa in aten::call_layer
#2  0x7f8e5b2d123 in runner::attention_kv::prefetch
```
eng_matt: Looks like a prefetch path touching conv kernels while OOMing. Could be race w/ large toolcall buffers.
ml_oncall: Plan: (1) reproduce with the exact ACME payloads on staging; (2) add an OOM handler that triggers soft-fallback to quantized variant before hard kill; (3) add KV cache TTL eviction during streaming.
support_jen: CS wants ETA and repro steps they can run locally. Can we give a concise checklist?
eng_matt: Checklist for CS/repro: 1) set CONCURRENCY=20, 2) use ACME sample streaming payloads, 3) enable toolcall stubs that emit 4–6KB outputs per token, 4) watch nvml for mem growth, 5) check runner logs for segfault pattern.
sre_lead: I'll coordinate the routing switch and billing freeze. Deploy-bot, please note the rollback window.
deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-policy/ACME -> fallback-to-dedicated applied by eng_matt at 2026-03-18T15:25:10Z :white_check_mark:
customer_xavier: Appreciate the quick triage — we can throttle our clients, but need a short-term fix from you too. We're on standby to run repro if you share steps.
eng_matt: Sharing /tmp/acme-burst.json and a small runner script to CS now. Also enabling lower concurrency and model_pin for ACME route.
ml_oncall: Follow-up items (short): add streaming-KV TTL, OOM preflight for large-tool outputs, add alert when single-runner mem > 90%.
sre_lead: Assigning follow-ups to eng_matt & ml_oncall. Will create incident ticket with timeline + customer notes for CS.
support_jen: I'll update CS and ACME with the rollback, billing note, and repro checklist. :thumbsup:
eng_matt: Monitoring — will report back in 30m with runtime metrics and whether fallback stops OOMs.
ml_oncall: If anyone needs raw core dump or nvml dump I'll upload to the incident bucket and link.
support_jen: Thanks all.
